invented.why: The brief does not name the clinic.

invented.quote: Our last attorney search took five months, so we need to begin recruiting as soon as funding is certain.
invented.why: The brief does not state how long the clinic's last attorney search took.

invented.quote: A family fund has pledged $20,000 a year for both years.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a family fund or how the rest of the attorney's cost will be paid.

invented.quote: The clinic will cover the remaining $13,000 a year from its general budget.
invented.why: The brief does not state that $13,000 a year will come from the clinic's general budget, nor can $13,000 be calculated without the unstated $20,000 family fund pledge.

invented.quote: With this grant, we can hire promptly and keep two full-time eviction defense attorneys rather than one.
invented.why: The brief neither specifies that the attorneys are full-time nor states that the grant is to replace the departing attorney to stay at two attorneys rather than hire a third.

invented.quote: Every six months, we will report to the Foundation the number of cases opened and how each one ended.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a commitment to report to the foundation every six months.

invented.quote: Starting in January, we will request court-wide eviction outcome data from the [County] Clerk.
invented.why: The brief does not state that the clinic will request court-wide eviction outcome data from the county clerk starting in January.

invented.quote: With that data, by the end of the first grant year we can compare outcomes for represented and unrepresented tenants and report the difference to the Foundation.
invented.why: The brief does not mention obtaining comparison data by the end of the first grant year or reporting that comparison to the foundation.

invented.quote: Without this grant, the number of tenants we can represent will fall by half.
invented.why: The brief says the grant is to hire a third attorney, not that without the grant the clinic cannot replace the departing second attorney.
